title: Phytip Protein A, ProPlus, ProPlus LX Columns: Plate Prep
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Transfer equilibration buffer
steps.instruction: Using the 8‑channel pipette, transfer 200 µL of equilibration buffer from the reagent stock reservoir in slot 8 to each well of the “Equilibration” plate in slot 9.

steps.title: Transfer wash buffer 1
steps.instruction: Using the 8‑channel pipette, transfer 200 µL of wash buffer 1 from the reagent stock reservoir in slot 8 to each well of the “1st wash” plate in slot 5.

steps.title: Transfer wash buffer 2
steps.instruction: Using the 8‑channel pipette, transfer 200 µL of wash buffer 2 from the reagent stock reservoir in slot 8 to each well of the “2nd wash” plate in slot 7.

steps.title: Transfer elution buffer
steps.instruction: Using the 8‑channel pipette, transfer 80 µL of elution buffer from the reagent stock reservoir in slot 8 to each well of the “Elution” plate in slot 11.
